$comment: §5 compliance calendar rules — data, never code. Dates here are the brief's illustrative schedule; each year-start the owner re-verifies against current-year official instructions (the year's form_captions/holidays tables carry the authority). due.type: fixed {month,day,taxYearOffset?} · multi_fixed {dates:[[m,d,label,yearOffset?],…]} · anniversary_month {month, everyNYears, baseYear} · event {event} (generated when the event exists, e.g. an actual pay run). All due dates roll forward past weekends and verified holidays.

rules.name: Form 941 (Q4), Form 940, W-2 to employee + W-2/W-3 to SSA, NYS-45 (Q4), any 1099-NEC
rules.channel: IRS e-file product / SSA BSO / NY Online Services
rules.notes: For the prior tax year's December payroll. Seasonal-employer box keeps zero-wage quarters unfiled federally; NYS-45 files all four quarters.

rules.name: NYS-45 zero-wage quarterly returns (Q1–Q3)
rules.notes: Zero-wage quarters still file in NY.

rules.name: Form 1120-S + K-1 (or 7004 extension); CT-3-S; NYC GCT return; PTET annual return if elected
rules.channel: e-file product / NY Online Services / NYC
rules.notes: Confirm the GCT due date each year in the NYC-4S instructions.

rules.name: Employer 401(k) contribution for the prior year (deadline moves with a filed extension)
NYS (and NYC if elected) PTET estimated payments
NYS PTET election deadline (and NYC PTET) — decide with the CPA
Owner 1040-ES and IT-2105 estimated payments
rules.channel: IRS Direct Pay / NY Online Services
rules.notes: December withholding is treated as paid evenly through the year; the projection module says how much residual ES remains.

rules.name: Before the December pay date: 401(k) deferral election on file; comp methodology + wage signed off; accountable-plan batch approved
Pre-year written consent (§4.9): comp methodology, accountable plan, 401(k) election, de minimis election
NY LLC biennial statement (formation anniversary month)
Form 5500-EZ (solo 401(k) assets over the filing threshold)
EFTPS federal deposit after the December pay run (monthly rule, or next business day if the $100k rule trips)
rules.notes: Generated from the actual posted pay run's deposit schedule (Phase 3).

rules.name: NYS-1 within 5 business days of the pay date (3 if prior-year withholding ≥ $15k)
NY new-hire report within 20 days of the owner's first pay date
